# ContentFlow (https://content-flow-weld-one.vercel.app)

> ContentFlow is a multi-channel creator studio and distribution queue for YouTube and TikTok creators. It turns a single idea into platform-ready scripts, captions, storyboards, subtitles, and scheduled posts under a $0-budget architecture.

## Key Public Pages
- `/` : Marketing landing page, interactive workflow overview, USD/NGN pricing with 30-day free trial, and detailed FAQ (`NO. 01` to `NO. 08`).
- `/login` : Creator sign-in supporting Email + Password, Email Magic Link / 6-digit code, and Google OAuth.
- `/signup` : Creator registration with entropy-based password coaching and one-click strong passphrase generation.
- `/privacy` : Privacy policy covering Row-Level Security (RLS), AES-256-GCM BYOK encryption, and data deletion.
- `/terms` : Terms of service, FTC Click-to-Cancel trial/subscription rules, and acceptable use.
- `/api/v1/openapi.json` : Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 specification for all `/api/v1/*` endpoints.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI Content Studio (`/create`)**: Script, image prompt, and video storyboard generation with Cloudflare Workers AI, Hugging Face, and AES-256-GCM encrypted BYOK (OpenAI / Replicate).
- **Platform Adaptation (`/content/[id]`)**: YouTube & TikTok metadata adaptation, Virality Score Analyzer, A/B Title & Hook Lab, Auto-Chapter Generator, Teleprompter, and SRT/VTT Subtitle export.
- **Distribution Queue (`/jobs`)**: Transactional `SKIP LOCKED` job queue with iCal (`.ics`) feed export and batch retry/cancel.
- **Billing & Trials (`/settings?section=Billing`)**: 1-click 30-day free trial on Creator and Pro plans, Promo Code redemption, and dual-currency (USD/NGN) Paystack checkout.
